primary_reference.paper: David Gaddy and Dan Klein. Pre-Learning Environment Representations for Data-Efficient Neural Instruction Following. ACL 2019, P19-1188.

methods.name: Environment-first
procedure: pretrain the transition encoder and action-conditioned decoder only from language-free (state_t, action_t, state_t_plus_1) rows
freeze the pretrained transition encoder and decoder
train the instruction encoder to match the pretrained discrete environment-message space
evaluate instruction following with the frozen environment representation path

methods.name: End-to-end
procedure: initialize the same inference topology without environment pretraining
train from the same instruction-following rows and labels
match the Environment-first inference parameter budget exactly

methods.name: State-only
procedure: remove instruction input while retaining the same state/action schema
use only as a diagnostic control and never as the primary baseline

transfer_conditions.held_out_entity: measure only if an explicit generator-backed entity split is constructed and audited; otherwise report unsupported
transfer_conditions.held_out_language_form: measure only if an explicit utterance-form split is constructed and audited; otherwise report unsupported

required_metrics: paired Environment-first minus End-to-end gaps on identical instances
resource_measurements: CPU inference latency per environment step

execution_gate.official_r01_100m_three_seed_reproductio: required before R0.2 capability comparison is accepted
execution_gate.source_trajectory_eligibility: must be recomputed from the official 100M checkpoints; reduced-contract RUN100 trajectories remain ineligible
allowed_before_gate: non-capability smoke execution that is explicitly labeled as such

failure_policy: Preserve the first reproducible failure with raw logs and immutable inputs. Change only the minimum fidelity or execution defect. Do not replace the public method with a new toy objective, do not count latent-space appearance or compression as progress, and do not claim novelty or an intelligence principle before the full reproduction is accepted.
